Read: node tools/harness/arm-ms.ts m2-motive-time-1116, node tools/harness/run-verdict.ts m2-motive-time-1116. Stop rule: pooled on - off gain under 1.0 ms/s on BP and on IP = park M2 (YRows stays 0); also park when the correctness job's exits per entry make the modelled exit cost >= the gain. ON only if both worlds gain >= 1.0 ms/s and both ABBA halves agree in sign. Game: Apex + bridge (Bin state apex).
